posts.headline: PUK reportedly weighing legal case against Masrour Barzani over caretaker overreach
posts.summary: With KDP-PUK relations effectively collapsed, the PUK is said to be considering filing a case against PM Masrour Barzani on grounds his caretaker government has wielded full executive authority for over three and a half years past constitutional limits.

posts.headline: Nechirvan Barzani positions himself as KDP moderate by meeting Halbousi in Baghdad
posts.summary: After the KDP's earlier announced withdrawal from Iraqi cabinet talks, Nechirvan Barzani's Baghdad sit-down with Speaker Mohammed al-Halbousi reads as the KDP's moderate face keeping the party engaged in the formation negotiation.

posts.headline: Four Duhok activists in detention for over five weeks for criticizing KRG policy
posts.summary: Rashid Kochar, Rebar Emenki, Sabah Atroshi and Divan Ahmed remain held in Duhok five-plus weeks after being detained for public criticism of KRG governance and rising electricity costs, with the regional human rights commission confirming continued detention.

posts.headline: Unprecedented US reconnaissance flight activity over the Strait of Hormuz
posts.summary: Reports flag unusually heavy American spy-plane activity over the Strait of Hormuz in the wake of the recent Iranian strikes on shipping in the strait. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Claim of a tightly designed Iranian play inside the new Iraqi cabinet formation
posts.summary: Quote-tweet endorsement of a report claiming a meticulously engineered Iranian-aligned plan around the new Iraqi government, framed as something so audacious followers would not believe it if explained. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Critique of Iraqi political factions fixated on ministerial portfolio shares
posts.summary: Video commentary skewering the political blocs for treating cabinet formation purely as a ministry-share contest at the expense of any program-of-government substance. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Culture minister referring Al-Qashlah heritage site to investment raises concerns
posts.summary: The Culture Minister approving a referral of the historic Al-Qashlah complex to investment is drawing pushback over fears of commercialization or a 50-year lease arrangement of a national heritage asset. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Civil aviation effectively cleared from Iraqi, Iranian, Syrian and Lebanese airspace
posts.summary: Reports unusual near-empty civilian skies across Iraq, Iran, Syria and Lebanon in synchrony with the live US-Iran tension cycle, suggesting carriers are pre-positioning for an escalation. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Arab states condemn Iran for the UAE strikes, Iraqi government stays silent
posts.summary: Notes that Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain and Syria have all issued formal condemnations of the Iranian strikes on the UAE while the al-Sudani caretaker government has not put out an equivalent statement. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: FlyDubai cancels Baghdad-route flights citing renewed US-Iran hostilities
posts.summary: FlyDubai is reported to be suspending its Baghdad service in response to the renewed US-Iran tension, an early commercial-aviation signal that carriers are pulling back from Iraqi airspace risk. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iraqi National Intelligence Service intercepts a major captagon and hashish ring
posts.summary: INIS reports the seizure of more than one million captagon pills and 100 kilograms of hashish and the arrest of an international trafficking network operating across multiple governorates. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Tom Barrack reportedly under federal investigation in connection with Iraq files
posts.summary: Claim that the US Syria envoy and ambassador to Türkiye is the subject of a federal probe tied to Iraq-related dealings, surfaced inside the broader Iraq-Hormuz news cycle. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Germany said to be lining up a substantive contribution to the Hormuz protection coalition
posts.summary: Reports that Berlin is preparing a sizeable contribution to the international maritime safety coalition forming around the strait, expanding the coalition's European footprint beyond the US and UK posture. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Second wave of Iranian missiles reported targeting the UAE
posts.summary: Flags additional Iranian missile activity against UAE targets following the earlier Monday volley, consistent with the UAE Defence Ministry tally of 12 ballistic missiles, 3 cruise missiles and 4 drones. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: UAE shutters airspace to civilian traffic during the Iranian missile and drone wave
posts.summary: Reports the UAE temporarily suspending civilian aviation operations as the air-defence engagement against the Iranian volley and drone strikes was ongoing. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Parliament Finance Committee assures public-sector salaries will be paid on time
posts.summary: The Finance Committee guarantees timely public-sector compensation despite the fiscal pressure from the export halt and the war cycle, a politically pre-emptive line on the most sensitive household-level variable. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Roughly 20 aerial-refuelling tankers identified across the regional theater
posts.summary: Open-source tracking flags a notably large refuelling-aircraft footprint over the region, characterized as a concerning indicator of imminent sustained air operations. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Al-Zaidi confirms cabinet submission next week and KRG salary settlement commitment
posts.summary: Picks up the al-Zaidi line that the new ministerial formation will be presented to parliament early-to-mid next week and that the Kurdistan Region salary issue will be resolved inside the new government. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: UAE confirms 15 missiles and 4 drones engaged in the day's attack
posts.summary: Records the UAE official tally of the Monday volley at 15 missiles and 4 drones, with the Defence Ministry framing it as an unprovoked Iranian attack on civilian sites and facilities. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Yemeni Leclerc tank company spotted near Al Anad or on the Taizz-Hodeida front
posts.summary: Geolocation read on a Yemeni Leclerc-equipped company either at Al Anad airbase or pushing onto the Taizz-Hodeida axis, against the backdrop of the regional escalation cycle.

posts.headline: Retrospective on a US 'finish' phase that was disastrously handled
posts.summary: Knights criticizes how a particular US military finish phase was executed in retrospect, framed as an instructive operational lesson rather than a current-event take.

posts.headline: UAE Mirage pilots get a Knights endorsement during the air defence engagement
posts.summary: An off-the-cuff Knights compliment to UAE Mirage pilots, posted in the middle of the UAE air-defence engagement against the Iranian missile and drone wave.

posts.headline: Quip on Iranian missile interception, May the 4th treatment
posts.summary: Knights deadpans that an interception over UAE airspace was 'obviously an ion cannon,' wishing followers a happy May the 4th in the middle of the air-defence cycle.

posts.headline: Knights notes a Yemeni jaish commander operating in full PPE
posts.summary: Brief commentary marking a Yemeni-army commander captured operating in full personal protective equipment, an aside on regional kit standards.

posts.headline: RT: CENTCOM's Cooper says Iranian cruise missiles were the principal threat
posts.summary: Knights amplifies an OSINT-account quote of CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper attributing the principal threat in the latest UAE engagement to Iranian cruise missiles rather than ballistic systems.

posts.headline: RT: CENTCOM's Cooper credits UAE with exceptional air-defence capabilities
posts.summary: Knights amplifies a journalist's quote of Adm. Brad Cooper highlighting the UAE's exceptional capabilities during the Monday air-defence engagement against the Iranian volley.

posts.headline: Knights notes a possibly material development in the Iraqi cabinet talks
posts.summary: A short Knights quote-tweet flagging a development in the Zaidi cabinet formation cycle as potentially significant if it pans out, signalling fluidity inside the negotiation.

posts.headline: Knights flags Ihsan al-Awadi and Hamid al-Ghazzi inside the Iraqi cabinet conversation
posts.summary: Identifies Ihsan al-Awadi and Hamid al-Ghazzi as figures showing up inside the live Zaidi cabinet bargain, expanding the visible roster of Coordination Framework operators around the negotiation.

posts.headline: Knights jabs at anyone trying to disrupt 'Project Freedom'
posts.summary: Light-touch quote-tweet riffing on the branding of Trump's US Navy escort operation through the Strait of Hormuz, posted on the operation's first day.

posts.headline: RT: BREAKING flagged on fighter jets reported over multiple southern Iranian cities
posts.summary: Knights amplifies an open-source report of fighter-jet activity over several southern Iranian cities, the kind of indicator-of-activity the regional Hormuz cycle has been generating.

posts.headline: RT: Surprise that the US had not engaged earlier in the cycle
posts.summary: Knights amplifies a Parker take expressing surprise that US forces had not engaged earlier in the Hormuz cycle, providing an outside framing of the Project Freedom timing call.

posts.headline: Knights reads sudden Iraqi MP and Oil Ministry warmth toward the KRG
posts.summary: Quote-tweet noting MPs and Iraqi Oil Ministry figures suddenly being notably nice to the KRG, framed as evidence the federal-Region bargain is moving inside the al-Zaidi negotiation.
